component.name: PipeWire Audio Settings
component.summary: Change PipeWire sample rate and bit depth

description.p: A GTK3 tool for controlling audio sample rate and bit depth on PipeWire.

ul.li: Manual sample rate control with Auto (bit-perfect) and Fixed modes
Per-rate mapping: send each input rate bit-perfect or rescale it up/down
Upscale below 44.1 kHz and downscale above 192 kHz (8 kHz to 384 kHz)
Background auto-apply via a system tray icon that reacts to input rate changes
Per-device bit depth (S16LE, S24LE, S24_32LE, S32LE) through WirePlumber rules
Shows which rates and formats each output device supports
